72672-the-true-history-of-the-ghost.title: _All About Metempsychosis_.
72672-the-true-history-of-the-ghost.creator: Professor Pepper,
72672-the-true-history-of-the-ghost.description: A book by Professor Pepper,. on in 1862 had closed its doors, and the reaction from the bustle attendant on the arrival and departure of country visitors had set in, so that the halls and lecture rooms lately crowded with the numerous patrons of the old Royal Polytechnic were somewhat deserted, there came to the aid of the Institute a new invention, which people by common consent called “The Ghost.”

arxiv-2102-03484.title: Hydrogen Atom in the Cosmic Microwave Background
arxiv-2102-03484.creator: Jose A. Magpantay
arxiv-2102-03484.description: Abstract The cosmic microwave background covers the entire universe which suggests the absence of any closed system, except the universe itself. In this paper, I consider the effect of the cosmic microwave background on the hydrogen atom, which must be very small otherwise changes in energy levels would have been measurable. But how small is small?

arxiv-2103-07584.title: Free-form Design of Discrete Architectural Surfaces by use of Circle Packing
arxiv-2103-07584.creator: Shizuo Kaji, Jingyao Zhang
arxiv-2103-07584.description: Abstract This paper presents an efficient approach for the conceptual design of architectural surfaces which are composed of triangular panels. In the free-form design of discrete architectural surfaces, the Gaussian curvature plays an important role not only aesthetically but also in terms of stiffness and constructability. However, designing a surface manually with specific Gaussian curvatures can be a time-consuming task.

arxiv-2108-12772.title: Space-Fractional Diffusion with Variable Order and Diffusivity: Discretization and Direct Solution Strategies
arxiv-2108-12772.creator: Hasnaa Alzahrani, George Turkiyyah, Omar Knio, David Keyes
arxiv-2108-12772.description: Abstract We consider the multidimensional space-fractional diffusion equations with spatially varying diffusivity and fractional order. Significant computational challenges are encountered when solving these equations due both to the kernel singularity in the fractional integral operator and to the resulting dense discretized operators, which quickly become prohibitively expensive to handle because of their memory and arithmetic complexities.

arxiv-2308-03673.title: w 1 + ∞ w_{1+\infty} and Carrollian Holography
arxiv-2308-03673.creator: Amartya Saha
arxiv-2308-03673.description: Abstract In a 1 + 2 1+2 D Carrollian conformal field theory, the Ward identities of the two local fields S 0 + S^{+}_{0} and S 1 + S^{+}_{1} , entirely built out of the Carrollian conformal stress-tensor, contain respectively up to the leading and the subleading positive helicity soft graviton theorems in the 1 + 3 1+3 D asymptotically

arxiv-2310-13200.title: A Deep Learning Analysis of Climate Change, Innovation, and Uncertainty We are grateful for valuable suggestions and comments from Victor Duarte (discussant), Harrison Hong, Felix Kubler, Simon Scheidegger, Jose Scheinkman, and Rebecca Willett. We also thank participants at the 19th Annual Olin Fina
arxiv-2310-13200.creator: Michael Barnett, William Brock, Lars Peter Hansen, Ruimeng Hu, Joseph Huang
arxiv-2310-13200.description: Abstract We study the implications of model uncertainty in a climate-economics framework with three types of capital: “dirty” capital that produces carbon emissions when used for production, “clean” capital that generates no emissions but is initially less productive than dirty capital, and knowledge capital that increases with R&D investment and leads to technological innovation in green sector productivity.

arxiv-2402-13484.title: WiFeS observations of nearby southern Type Ia supernova host galaxies DOI: 10.1017/pasa.XXXX.XX
arxiv-2402-13484.creator: Anthony Carr, Tamara M. Davis, Ryan Camilleri, Chris Lidman, Kenneth C. Freeman, Dan Scolnic
arxiv-2402-13484.description: Abstract We present high-resolution observations of nearby ( z ≲ 0.1 z\lesssim 0.1 ) galaxies that have hosted Type Ia supernovae to measure systemic spectroscopic redshifts using the Wide Field Spectrograph (WiFeS) instrument on the Australian National University 2.3 m telescope at Siding Spring Observatory.

arxiv-2406-16098.title: 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} Symmetric Non-Hermitian Cavity Magnomechanics
arxiv-2406-16098.creator: Yu Chengyong, Kashif Ammar Yasir
arxiv-2406-16098.description: Abstract We design and explore PT-symmetric behavior of a hybrid non-Hermitian cavity magnomechanics consisting of a ferromagnetic YIG sphere driven by external magnetic field. Non-Hermicity is engineered by using a traveling field directly interacting with YIG. The external magnetic field excites collective mechanical modes of magnons, which later excites cavity mode leading to a coupling between cavity magnons and photons.

arxiv-2409-07028.title: Adaptive Error-Bounded Hierarchical Matrices for Efficient Neural Network Compression
arxiv-2409-07028.creator: John Mango, Ronald Katende
arxiv-2409-07028.description: Abstract This paper introduces a dynamic, error-bounded hierarchical matrix (H-matrix) compression method tailored for Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). The proposed approach reduces the computational complexity and memory demands of large-scale physics-based models while preserving the essential properties of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK).

arxiv-2501-10876.title: Certifying Robustness via Topological Representations
arxiv-2501-10876.creator: Jens Agerberg, Andrea Guidolin, Andrea Martinelli, Pepijn Roos Hoefgeest, David Eklund, Martina Scolamiero
arxiv-2501-10876.description: Abstract \jmlrpages † † editors: Christian Shewmake, Simone Azeglio, Bahareh Tolooshams, Sophia Sanborn, Nina Miolane † † year: 2024 † † workshop: Neurips Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations 1 Introduction In machine learning, the ability to obtain data representations that capture underlying geometrical and topological structures of data spaces is crucial.

arxiv-2504-13018.title: High Dimensional Sparse Canonical Correlation Analysis for Elliptical Symmetric Distributions
arxiv-2504-13018.creator: Chengde Qian, Yanhong Liu ∗, Long Feng
arxiv-2504-13018.description: Abstract This paper proposes a robust high-dimensional sparse canonical correlation analysis (CCA) method for investigating linear relationships between two high-dimensional random vectors, focusing on elliptical symmetric distributions. Traditional CCA methods, based on sample covariance matrices, struggle in high-dimensional settings, particularly when data exhibit heavy-tailed distributions.

arxiv-2506-19937.title: The Most Important Features in Generalized Additive Models Might Be Groups of Features
arxiv-2506-19937.creator: Tomas Bosschieter, Luis França, Jessica Wolk, Yiyuan Wu, Bella Mehta, M.D, Joseph Dehoney, Orsolya Kiss, Fiona C. Baker, Qingyu Zhao, Rich Caruana, Kilian M. Pohl
arxiv-2506-19937.description: Abstract While analyzing the importance of features has become ubiquitous in interpretable machine learning, the joint signal from a group of related features is sometimes overlooked or inadvertently excluded. Neglecting the joint signal could bypass a critical insight: in many instances, the most significant predictors are not isolated features, but rather the combined effect of groups of features.

arxiv-2508-15720.title: WorldWeaver: Generating Long-Horizon Video Worlds via Rich Perception
arxiv-2508-15720.creator: Zhiheng Liu, Xueqing Deng, Shoufa Chen, Angtian Wang, Qiushan Guo, Mingfei Han, Zeyue Xue, Mengzhao Chen, Ping Luo, Linjie Yang
arxiv-2508-15720.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhiheng Liu, Xueqing Deng, Shoufa Chen, Angtian Wang, Qiushan Guo, Mingfei Han, Zeyue Xue, Mengzhao Chen, Ping Luo, Linjie Yang. Generative video modeling has made significant strides, yet ensuring structural and temporal consistency over long sequences remains a challenge. Current methods predominantly rely on RGB signals, leading to accumulated errors in object structure and motion over extended durations.

arxiv-2509-08293.title: Tensorial representations of positive weakly ( q , r ) (q,r) -dominated multilinear operators
arxiv-2509-08293.creator: Abdelaziz Belaada, Adel Bounabab, Athmane Ferradi and Khalil Saadi
arxiv-2509-08293.description: Abstract . We introduce and study the class of positive weakly ( q , r ) (q,r) -dominated multilinear operators between Banach lattices. This notion extends classical domination and summability concepts to the positive multilinear setting and generates a new positive multi-ideal. A Pietsch domination theorem and a polynomial version are established.

arxiv-2509-10784.title: Adapting Medical Vision Foundation Models for Volumetric Medical Image Segmentation via Active Learning and Selective Semi-supervised Fine-tuning
arxiv-2509-10784.creator: Jin Yang, Daniel S. Marcus, Aristeidis Sotiras
arxiv-2509-10784.description: Abstract Medical Vision Foundation Models (Med-VFMs) have superior capabilities of interpreting medical images due to the knowledge learned from self-supervised pre-training with extensive unannotated images. To improve their performance on adaptive downstream evaluations, especially segmentation, a few samples from target domains are selected randomly for fine-tuning them.

arxiv-2510-20842.title: Fractional harmonic transform on point cloud manifolds
arxiv-2510-20842.creator: Jiamian Li, Bing-Zhao Li
arxiv-2510-20842.description: Abstract Three-dimensional point clouds can be viewed as discrete samples of smooth manifolds, allowing spectral analysis using the Laplace-Beltrami operator (LBO). However, the traditional point cloud manifold harmonic transform (PMHT) is limited by its fixed basis functions and single spectral representation, which restricts its ability to capture complex geometric features.

arxiv-2601-06612.title: Cross-Border Data Security and Privacy Risks in Large Language Models and IoT Systems
arxiv-2601-06612.creator: Chalitha Handapangoda
arxiv-2601-06612.description: Abstract The reliance of Large Language Models and Internet of Things systems on massive, globally distributed data flows creates systemic security and privacy challenges. When data traverses borders, it becomes subject to conflicting legal regimes, such as the EU’s General Data Protection Regulation and China’s Personal Information Protection Law, compounded by technical vulnerabilities like model memorization.

arxiv-2602-19835.title: Monodromy Rank and the Semisimple Mumford–Tate Conjecture for Hyper-Kähler Varieties
arxiv-2602-19835.creator: Zhichao Tang, Haitao Zou
arxiv-2602-19835.description: Abstract . In this paper, we establish two main results concerning the Mumford–Tate conjecture for hyper-Kähler varieties. First, we prove the conjecture for the semisimplified ℓ \ell -adic Galois representations attached to hyper-Kähler varieties with second Betti number b 2 ≥ 4 b_{2}\geq 4 .

arxiv-2602-20822.title: Hölder-Logarithmic Stability and Convergence Rates for an Inverse Random Source Problem Thanks: Submitted to the editors January 30th 2026.
arxiv-2602-20822.creator: Philipp Ronald Mickan, Thorsten Hohage
arxiv-2602-20822.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate an inverse random source problem concerned with recovering the strength of a random, uncorrelated acoustic source from correlation measurements of emitted time-harmonic acoustic waves. Such problems arise in applications including aeroacoustics and seismic imaging. Unlike their deterministic counterparts, inverse random source problems are known to be uniquely solvable in the absence of noise.

europmc-pmc2778451.title: Role of vitamin d in insulin secretion and insulin sensitivity for glucose homeostasis.
europmc-pmc2778451.creator: Alvarez JA, Ashraf A.
europmc-pmc2778451.description: Vitamin D functions are not limited to skeletal health benefits and may extend to preservation of insulin secretion and insulin sensitivity. This review summarizes the literature related to potential vitamin D influences on glucose homeostasis and insulin sensitivity....

europmc-pmc4503453.title: Widespread Polycistronic Transcripts in Fungi Revealed by Single-Molecule mRNA Sequencing.
europmc-pmc4503453.creator: Gordon SP, Tseng E, Salamov A, Zhang J, Meng X, Zhao Z, Kang D, Underwood J, Grigoriev IV, Figueroa M, Schilling JS, Chen F, Wang Z.
europmc-pmc4503453.description: Genes in prokaryotic genomes are often arranged into clusters and co-transcribed into polycistronic RNAs. Isolated examples of polycistronic RNAs were also reported in some higher eukaryotes but their presence was generally considered rare. Here we developed a long-read...

light-o-the-morning-the-story-of-an-iris.creator: L. T. Meade

pmc-10503299.title: Navigating the challenges of invasive pulmonary aspergillosis in lung cancer treatment: a propensity score study
pmc-10503299.creator: Chin-Wei Kuo, Chien-Yu Lin, Sheng-Huan Wei, Yun-Tse Chou, Chian-Wei Chen, Jeng-Shiuan Tsai, Po-Lan Su, Chien-Chung Lin
pmc-10503299.description: Background:Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis (IPA) can negatively impact cancer patients’ survival. It remains uncertain whether IPA’s impact on patient outcomes varies by treatment approach in advanced lung cancer.Objectives:To explore the association between IPA and outcomes in patients with advanced lung cancer receiving different treatments.Design:A retrospective cohort study.

pmc-10630793.title: Pharmacological, nutraceutical, and nutritional properties of flaxseed (Linum usitatissimum): An insight into its functionality and disease mitigation
pmc-10630793.creator: Sana Noreen, Tabussam Tufail, Huma Bader Ul Ain, Chinaza Godswill Awuchi
pmc-10630793.description: Flaxseed (Linum usitatissimum L.) is derived from the flax plant, an annual herb. The primary relevance of flaxseed is in the human nutrition sector, where it is emerging as a significant functional food component due to its high level of active chemicals, which have been linked to health benefits.

pmc-11585630.title: A motor bearing fault diagnosis model based on multi-adversarial domain adaptation
pmc-11585630.creator: Xin-Ming Liu, Rui-Ming Zhang, Jin-Ping Li, Yu-Fei Xu, Kun Li
pmc-11585630.description: In response to the weakened capability of feature transfer and parameter distribution alignment across domains due to significant differences in data distribution collected by different devices, this paper constructs a motor bearing fault diagnosis model based on multi-adversarial domain adaptation. Initially, an improved residual network is employed as the feature extraction module to enhance feature extraction capabilities.

pmc-11688900.title: THE PARADOX OF CONNECTION: MUTUAL FOLLOWING’S IMPACT ON LONELINESS AMONG OLDER ADULTS IN ONLINE NETWORKS
pmc-11688900.creator: Nahyun Kim, Keiko Katagiri
pmc-11688900.description: Online communities serve as a resource for many older adults to create new connections, such as friendships and acquaintanceships that can help alleviate loneliness. Despite the many advantages, there is a lack of research on the network size in online communities tailored for older adults and its effects on loneliness reduction.

pmc-11712878.title: Using a Bayesian workflow approach to define the optimal level of anatomy/functionality voxels clustering for the prediction of tau propagation and cortical loss in Alzheimer's disease
pmc-11712878.creator: Jean‐Paul Soucy, Clyde J Belasso, Zhengchen Cai, Gleb Bezgin, Jenna Stevenson, Nesrine Rahmouni, Cécile Tissot, Firoza Z Lussier, Pedro Rosa‐Neto, Hassan J Rivaz, Habib Benali
pmc-11712878.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTau aggregates in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) induce loss of synapses and neurons, leading to cognitive impairment. Predicting tau and neurodegeneration temporal evolution could be used for prognostication and for assessing results of therapeutic trials. Tau PET and MRI volumetry are reliable markers of disease stage, but cost and radiation protection considerations limit research measurement frequency, lowering the accuracy of disease progression modeling.

pmc-12976082.title: Pharyngeal electrical stimulation for postextubation dysphagia after stroke: a randomized trial on hospitalization costs from a health insurance perspective
pmc-12976082.creator: Bendix Labeit, Anne Jung, Jonas von Itter, Inga Claus, Sigrid Ahring, Tobias Warnecke, Paul Muhle, Almut Kremer, Sven G Meuth, Rainer Dziewas, Sonja Suntrup-Krueger
pmc-12976082.description: Dysphagia is a frequent and serious complication after stroke, associated with pneumonia, malnutrition, prolonged intensive care unit stay, and higher healthcare costs. Pharyngeal electrical stimulation (PES) is a novel therapy that may support recovery from postextubation dysphagia. This study assessed the cost-effectiveness of PES in stroke patients from a health insurance perspective.

pmc-13323256.title: Efficacy and safety of platelet-rich plasma injection for hemophilic chronic synovitis and arthropathy: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13323256.creator: Shaoyu Yin, Yijia Lu, Qi He, Hui Bi, Zeping Zhou
pmc-13323256.description: Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) has emerged as a potential therapeutic approach for hemophilia. Systematically summarize the evidence regarding the efficacy and safety of PRP therapy in hemophilia. PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched. Risk of bias was assessed using Cochrane Risk of Bias (RoB 2) and the RoB for Non-Randomized Studies of interventions (ROBINS-I V2).

pmc-13407350.title: Association Between Vitamin D Deficiency and the Incidence of Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13407350.creator: Angelica Cersosimo, Lucio Teresi, Marco Valerio Mariani, Riccardo Rovelli, Nicola Pierucci, Vincenzo Mirco La Fazia, Chiara Camastra, Giovanni Fazio, Enrico Vizzardi
pmc-13407350.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Vitamin D has been implicated in several biological pathways involved in atrial remodeling, yet its association with incident atrial fibrillation (AF) remains uncertain across epidemiological studies. Objectives: The objective was to evaluate the association between circulating vitamin D levels and the risk of incident AF through a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective studies using a harmonized continuous analytical framework. Methods: A systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective cohort studies was performed.

pmc-13447624.title: A scoping review of outcomes and implementation challenges of mental health care interventions among conflict-affected populations in Africa
pmc-13447624.creator: Olivier Sibomana, Tolulope Joseph Ogunniyi, Boluwatife Samuel Fatokun, Jildas Munyantore, Esther Edet Bassey, Gabriel Oke, Leonard Uzairue, Kehinde Precious Fadele, Melody Okereke, Egide Ndayambaje
pmc-13447624.description: IntroductionConflict across Africa has led to widespread displacement, trauma, and mental health disorders, with limited access to care in already resource-constrained health systems. This scoping review is aimed at mapping existing evidence on mental health interventions for conflict-affected populations in Africa, examining their types, outcomes, and implementation challenges, to inform future policy, practice, and research.

pmc-13530377.title: Nationwide Lifespan Trends in Cardiac Implantable Electronic Device Strategies in Japan: Age‐Dependent Changes in Transvenous and Epicardial Systems
pmc-13530377.creator: Aya Miyazaki, Gaku Izumi, Shuhei Fujita, Tsugutoshi Suzuki, Hiroshi Suzuki, Jun Yoshimoto, Keiko Toyohara, Yasunobu Hayabuchi, Masahiko Takagi
pmc-13530377.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundNationwide epidemiological studies of cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) encompassing multiple device types and strategies remain limited in Japan, particularly regarding epicardial lead use and pediatric populations.MethodsWe performed the first nationwide analysis of CIED implantation trends using the National Database of Health Insurance Claims, including transvenous (TV)/epicardial (Epi) systems for pacemakers, implantable cardioverter‐defibrillators (ICDs), cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT), and CRT‐defibrillators (CRTDs), as well as leadless pacemakers, subcutaneous ICDs (S‐ICDs), and epicardial lead use.

pmc-13587713.title: Sleep-disordered breathing in patients with group 1 and group 4 pulmonary hypertension
pmc-13587713.creator: Kemal Yüce, Selvi Aşkar, Müntecep Aşkar
pmc-13587713.description: IntroductionSleep-disordered breathing (SDB) is frequently observed in patients with pulmonary hypertension (PH) and may contribute to disease progression through recurrent nocturnal hypoxemia. However, data comparing SDB characteristics between Group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and Group 4 chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH) remain limited.
